cases.title: ABT Tap — a valid contactless card tap succeeds and the gate opens
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a route whose ABT Type is "Tap On Tap Off"
**AND** its home location is within the configured "Northern Ireland Zone"
**AND** the "ABT Tap Product Name" product (Product ID 6000) is configured
**AND** a valid, in-date Visa Debit card is presented to the reader

cases.title: ABT Tap — a successful tap posts an ABT audit record with zero revenue
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head has accepted a valid contactless tap at a rail station gate
**AND** the configured travel product is the NIR TOTO product (Product ID 6000)

cases.title: ABT Tap — the TapId is composed of DeviceId, TID and UNIX timestamp
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head with DeviceId 0420 and Terminal ID 02201156 has accepted a tap
**AND** an example composed TapId of 042002201156881725545715

cases.title: ABT Tap — an expired card is declined with Declined Reason 1
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service at a rail station gate
**AND** a contactless card whose expiry date has passed is presented

cases.title: ABT Tap — a card failing ODA is declined with Declined Reason 3
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a card that fails Offline Data Authentication is declined and audited with Declined Reason 3.

cases.title: ABT Tap — a card on the BIN List is declined with Declined Reason 15
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head has the daily BIN List downloaded from CloudFare
**AND** a contactless card whose BIN is on that BIN List is presented

cases.title: ABT Tap — a card on the Deny List is rejected in entry mode with Declined Reason 2
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a card on the Deny List is rejected and the gate stays closed when the GV is in an entry-only mode.

cases.title: ABT Tap — every declined check still posts an audit record
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service at a rail station gate
**AND** a card that will fail one of the card checks is presented

cases.title: ABT Tap — an offline transaction is accepted and queued for the back office
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service with the BIN List and Deny List already downloaded
**AND** the connection to the ABT back office is currently unavailable
**AND** a valid, in-date contactless card is presented

cases.title: ABT Tap — the reader stays disarmed when the route ABT Type is not Tap On Tap Off
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV reader does not arm when the first route at the home location is not an ABT Tap On Tap Off route.

cases.title: ABT Tap — the reader stays disarmed when the home location is outside the Northern Ireland Zone
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV reader does not arm when its home location falls outside the configured Northern Ireland Zone.

cases.title: ABT Tap — the reader stays disarmed when the ABT Tap Product is not configured
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV reader does not arm when no product matching the TMS "ABT Tap Product Name" exists.

cases.title: ABT Tap — an unreadable card presentation gives an error and the gate stays closed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an armed NIR GV head at a rail station gate
**AND** a card that cannot be read is presented to the reader

cases.title: ABT Tap — a Maestro card is not accepted at the GV
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an armed NIR GV head at a rail station gate
**AND** a Maestro card is presented to the reader

cases.title: ABT Tap — an exit-capable gate opens for a deny-listed card but audits the tap invalid
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is running in an exit or bi-directional Direction configuration
**AND** the Deny List is downloaded and a card on that Deny List is presented

cases.title: ABT Tap — an entry-configured gate audits the tap as a Tap On
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head running in an entry Direction configuration
**AND** a valid contactless card is tapped and accepted

cases.title: ABT Tap — an exit-configured gate audits the tap as a Tap Off
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head running in an exit Direction configuration
**AND** a valid contactless card is tapped and accepted

cases.title: Barcode — a valid multi-use barcode is accepted with a green tick and the gate opens
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid, in-date multi-use barcode for an Adult product is presented (Scheme ID 5720, format 01 Flowbird, mode RAIL 0002)

cases.title: Barcode — a barcode on a mobile device screen validates the same as a printed one
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid multi-use barcode is shown on a passenger's mobile device screen

cases.title: Barcode — a TVM-produced barcode validates at the GV
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid multi-use barcode ticket printed on a TVM is presented

cases.title: Barcode — an HHD-produced barcode validates at the GV
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid multi-use barcode ticket printed on an HHD is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a route/location-only failure gives a yellow question mark
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a barcode valid on time, mode, product and zone but not for this gate's location is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a failed validation gives a red cross with a reason
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a barcode that fails a check other than route/location is presented

cases.title: Barcode — an already-validated barcode is rejected
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a barcode already validated is rejected when presented again at the GV.

cases.title: Barcode — an expired barcode is rejected
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a multi-use barcode whose encoded expiry time has passed is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a rail barcode failing the location check is treated valid when the fare is at least the £90 fallback
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the rail fare-fallback (CR105.3) treats a location-failing barcode as valid when the product rule value is at least £90.

cases.title: Barcode — a rail barcode failing the location check is rejected when the fare is below the £90 fallback
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a rail barcode whose product rule value is below £90 fails the rail location check

cases.title: Barcode — a barcode validated on one gate head is rejected on another head of the same gateline
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** two NIR GV heads form a single gateline sharing barcode Unique IDs (CR105.2)
**AND** a multi-use barcode was already validated on the first head within the passback window

cases.title: Barcode — an expiry between midnight and 4am shows the previous day and no time
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head with CR116 enabled is in service
**AND** a barcode with an encoded expiry of 20240520-0400 is presented

cases.title: Barcode — an expiry just after 4am shows the same day with a time
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head with CR116 enabled is in service
**AND** a barcode with an encoded expiry of 20240520-0401 is presented

cases.title: Barcode — the read-to-beep response is within one second
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid multi-use barcode is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a new barcode presented during a result screen is processed immediately
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is showing a barcode result screen
**AND** a second valid multi-use barcode is presented before the screen times out

cases.title: Barcode — a successful validation posts a zero-fare BarcodeUsage transaction
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an NIR GV head has accepted a valid multi-use barcode with a green tick

cases.title: Barcode — a failed validation posts an event carrying the Unique ID and reason
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** an NIR GV head has rejected a barcode with a red cross

cases.title: Barcode — the GV validates multi-use barcodes
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid multi-use (not single-use) barcode is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a 3-Day Select ticket is valid on its start, additional and end dates
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a 3-Day Select barcode whose current date equals its Start date is presented

cases.title: Barcode — a barcode encoded for bus mode only is rejected on a rail gate
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a barcode encoded with mode BUS (0001) only is presented

cases.title: Passback — a barcode re-presented within the passback window is rejected
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a multi-use barcode was just validated successfully with a green tick

cases.title: Passback — a barcode re-presented after other transactions is still rejected within the window
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head validated a multi-use barcode, then processed other transactions
**AND** the original barcode's passback window has not yet elapsed

cases.title: Passback — a card re-tapped within the passback time is declined with Declined Reason 20
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head accepted a valid contactless tap
**AND** the same card is re-tapped within the configured TMS passback time

cases.title: Passback — a barcode presented on a second gateline head is rejected as passback
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** two NIR GV heads share barcode Unique IDs as one gateline (CR105.2)
**AND** a barcode was validated on the first head within the passback window

cases.title: Passback — a barcode presented after the passback window elapses is accepted
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head validated a multi-use barcode whose product permits re-use
**AND** the configured passback window has fully elapsed

cases.title: Commissioning — both GV heads boot into service after live software load
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a lane commissioned with the primary app zip on the P microSD and the secondary app zip on the S microSD
**AND** an example lane at York Street with the current live app pair loaded

cases.title: Commissioning — Primary head is Entry/unpaid and Secondary head is Exit/paid (roles not swapped)
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned lane with the P image on one head and the S image on the other
**AND** the entry/unpaid side is physically the approach side of an example York Street lane

cases.title: Commissioning — SkyLane interface firmware is HF03
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a commissioned lane whose SkyLane interface board is reachable at 192.168.0.200

cases.title: Commissioning — correct gate width variant (Standard vs Wide) is installed
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned lane that is physically a Standard 600 mm aisle
**AND** the SkyLane firmware ships in distinct Standard and Wide (disabled-access) variants

cases.title: Commissioning — one-wire homeLocation and zoneNo match the install spreadsheet
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned head whose one-wire chip was programmed in Maintenance Mode
**AND** the example install spreadsheet row gives homeLocation "RA" and zoneNo "128"

cases.title: Commissioning — Technician Location Settings match the install spreadsheet
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned head signed in to the Technician Location Settings screen
**AND** an example install-spreadsheet row for the York Street lane giving Home Location, Stop Location, Zone Number, Install Point ID and ID

cases.title: Router — each lane has a unique static WAN IP per the install spreadsheet
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned lane whose MicroTik router WAN is set to Mode Router, Address Acquisition Static
**AND** an example install-spreadsheet row allocating a unique WAN IP, netmask and gateway to the York Street lane

cases.title: Router — SkyLane at .200 with eth0 gateway .0.1 and a port-80 NAT rule
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a commissioned lane with the SkyLane board at 192.168.0.200 and its eth0 gateway set to 192.168.0.1
**AND** a NAT rule redirecting the router WAN IP port 80 to the interface board port 80

cases.title: Router — the router admin password is set (not blank)
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a commissioned lane router managed over SSH

cases.title: Software Distribution — a software / configuration / barcode-data file downloads to the GV
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service with a new software, configuration or barcode-data file staged for it in the back office

cases.title: Software Distribution — a configuration file with a future activation date applies on that date
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV that has downloaded a configuration file with an example activation date of tomorrow

cases.title: Technician Sign On — valid technician card reaches the Technician Menu
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a GV in service showing the idle Present Card or Barcode screen
**AND** the seeded technician card and PIN are available

cases.title: Technician Sign On — an invalid PIN is rejected
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV showing the technician PIN entry screen after a valid technician card

cases.title: Technician Sign On — an abandoned sign-on returns to the idle screen
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV showing the technician PIN entry screen after a valid technician card

cases.title: Technician Menu — the session auto signs off after the inactivity timeout
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician signed on to the Technician Menu
**AND** the configured inactivity timeout is in force

cases.title: Technician Menu — a technician navigates the menu pages
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician signed on to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Location Settings — a technician sets the GV location
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a technician on the Location Settings screen with comms to the back office
**AND** an example install-spreadsheet row giving Home Location, Stop Location, Zone Number, Install Point ID and ID

cases.title: Location Settings — location cannot be changed while comms to the back office is lost
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the Location Settings screen behaves correctly when the GV has no back-office comms.

cases.title: Software Versions — the Software Versions screen lists all software versions
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician signed on to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Configuration Versions — the Configuration Versions screen lists all configuration versions
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician signed on to the Technician Menu

cases.title: Display Brightness — a technician adjusts the screen brightness
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician on the Display Brightness screen

cases.title: Audio Volume — a technician adjusts the audio volume
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician on the Audio Volume screen

cases.title: Force Communications — a technician forces a comms session with the back office
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a technician on the Force Communications screen with a reachable back office

cases.title: Idle Screen — Present Card or Barcode
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service with no card or barcode presented

cases.title: Idle Screen — Not In Service
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV that is out of service

cases.title: Error Screen — Re-present Card
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV shows the Re-present Card screen when a card read must be retried.

cases.title: Error Screen — Not Valid At This Location
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service at an example location where the presented product is not valid

cases.title: Error Screen — Invalid Time Of Day
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and a card whose product is not valid at the current time of day

cases.title: Error Screen — Product Expired
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and a card whose product has expired

cases.title: Error Screen — Faulty Card
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and an example faulty (unreadable) card

cases.title: Error Screen — Not Accepted
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and a card that is not accepted

cases.title: Passback Screen — Card Already Validated
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV shows the Card Already Validated screen when a card is re-presented within the passback window.

cases.title: Success Screen — Successful
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and a valid card

cases.title: Barcode Error Screen — Barcode Already Validated
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the GV shows the Barcode Already Validated screen when a used barcode is re-presented.

cases.title: Barcode Error Screen — Barcode Has Expired
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and an expired multi-use barcode

cases.title: Barcode Error Screen — Barcode Not Valid At This Location
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV at an example location where the presented barcode product is not valid

cases.title: Barcode Error Screen — Barcode Type Invalid
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and an example barcode of an unrecognised type

cases.title: Barcode Success Screen — Barcode Use
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service and a valid multi-use barcode

cases.title: Power — the gate stays open when mains fails with a user inside the aisle
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service with a user positioned inside the aisle

cases.title: Power — a power loss of two seconds or less does not force a reboot
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service

cases.title: Emergency Release — the Emergency Release Button opens the gate
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service in a controlled mode

cases.title: Heartbeat — loss of a validator heartbeat raises a major fault
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service with the gate-to-validator heartbeat running at its configured rate of at least one per second

cases.title: Power-up — the gate is Out of Service until both validators communicate
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane powered off

cases.title: Mains restore — the gate returns to its previous operational mode
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm the gate returns to its previous operational mode when mains power is restored, absent a major fault.

cases.title: BOS Comms — the GV keeps validating and queues audit data while the back office is unreachable
cases.custom_steps: This test is to confirm a GV continues validating and queues its audit data when it cannot reach the back office.

cases.title: BOS Comms — queued audit data uploads to CloudFare when comms is restored
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV holding audit data queued during a back-office outage

cases.title: SaaS — a sustained Translink-network outage drives the GV to a communication-locked Out of Service state
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV routed to AWS through the Translink network

cases.title: Heartbeat — the GV updates CloudFare Last Communication at least every 15 minutes
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a GV in service with no validations occurring

cases.title: Throughput — Primary and Secondary heads sustain back-to-back validations
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a lane in service with both heads accepting validations
**AND** an example burst of valid cards and barcodes presented in quick succession to one head

cases.title: Smoke — both heads boot into service
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a commissioned lane powered off

cases.title: Smoke — a valid card opens the gate with a success screen and beep
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service and an example valid card

cases.title: Smoke — a valid multi-use barcode opens the gate with a success screen
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service and an example valid multi-use barcode

cases.title: Smoke — an immediate re-present of the same card is rejected as passback
cases.custom_steps: **GIVEN** a lane in service and a card just validated on the entry head

cases.title: Smoke — a technician can sign on to the Technician Menu
cases.custom_steps:
**GIVEN** a head in service showing the idle screen
**AND** the seeded technician card and PIN are available
